articles.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
articles.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack - one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

articles.title: Bashar al Assad sentenced to death in absentia by Syrian court for war crimes
articles.description: Former Syrian president Bashar al Assad has been sentenced to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes, following a ruling by a court in the country.

articles.title: Trump 'secretly left NATO summit on military plane over Iran threat'
articles.description: Donald Trump secretly left Turkey through a catering container to a military jet over a threat from Iran, according to US reports.

articles.title: British couple jailed in Iran end hunger strike after several months, family says
articles.description: A British couple jailed in Iran over alleged spying have ended a three-month-long hunger strike against their sentence, their son has said.
